title: Ginnel, snicket or twitten? Britain's alley words on the street signs
excerpt: I mapped all 3,382 named alleys in the UK by the word in their name. 88% of twittens are in Sussex, every chare is in the North East, and London's 375 named alleys use a regional word just 2 times.
seo_description: Every named alley in the UK mapped by its word: twitten, ginnel, snicket, jitty, chare, wynd, loke, ope. 88% of twittens are in Sussex.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Ginnel, snicket or twitten?' beside a map of Britain in coloured hexagons for the commonest alley word, wynd in Scotland, chare on Tyneside, loke in Norfolk and twitten in Sussex, with the line 88% of twittens are in Sussex.
